newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai says All Corp to seek liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokai says All Corp to seek liquidation.

text.p: Tokai Bank Ltd, a major creditor of troubled non-bank financial firm All Corp, said on Thursday that the non-bank had decided to seek liquidation.
A bank spokesman also said that the bank's loans to All Corp totalled 60.3 billion yen at the end of September 1996.

All Corp said earlier on Thursday it would hold a news conference at 10.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) on the issue of special liquidation after media reports said it would apply for court protection for special liquidation by the end of March.
The Tokai Bank spokesman said the bank had heard that All Corp directors had decided on Wednesday to seek liquidation.

The spokesman declined to comment when asked if the bank had set aside loan-loss provisions for its loans to the troubled non-bank, but banking sources said Tokai Bank had already covered the possible loan losses.

The Japanese financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Wednesday that All Corp would apply for court protection for special liquidation by the end of March with debts totalling 350 billion yen.
